system.description:
A mercenary assassin tradition — no fixed guild, travelling contracts, reputation-based. You answer to no owl, no council, no creed. Just the next mark and the next coin.

  • Mounted Strike: A creature your mount moved past this turn counts as unsuspecting for your Sneak Attack.
  • Open Contract: Advantage on checks establishing credentials and negotiating contract terms with new clients.
